note: Forever-free means no registration fee. You do not get a leftover .com. Freenom (.tk/.cf/.gq/.ga/.ml free regs) ended in 2024. Year-1 cheap TLDs are not $0 forever. Rechecked 2026-08-21.

programs.name: EU.org
programs.who: Anyone; aimed at people and nonprofits who cannot pay a NIC
programs.how: Request at nic.eu.org. Approval often takes about two weeks. Not the European Union. Site still live 21 Aug 2026.

programs.name: is-a.dev
programs.how: Open a pull request on is-a-dev/register. Repo was merging PRs 20 Aug 2026. They also launched .is-a.bot — same GitHub org, separate claim.

programs.name: thedev.id
programs.who: Developers who want a personal identity hostname
programs.how: Fork thedev.id, add a CNAME file for your slug, open a pull request. thedev.id now redirects to upset.dev/thedev.id; GitHub repo still unarchived.

programs.name: is-a-good.dev
programs.how: PR on is-a-good-dev/register. Repo was merging PRs as of 19 Aug 2026 — it is live.

programs.name: js.org
programs.who: JavaScript projects only — they turned down personal blogs
programs.how: Pull request on js-org/js.org. Need a real JS project. Repo was merging PRs 19 Aug 2026.

programs.name: GitHub Pages
programs.who: Anyone with a free GitHub account
programs.how: Create a repo named youruser.github.io. That is this site's host.

programs.name: Cloudflare Pages
programs.how: Deploy a Pages project. You get project.pages.dev. Not a TLD you own. Marketing URL redirects to cloudflare.com/products/pages.

programs.name: Netlify
programs.who: Anyone; bandwidth limits on free tier
programs.how: Deploy a site, pick a subdomain in the Netlify UI.

programs.name: FreeDNS (afraid.org)
programs.who: Anyone; public shared domains get a random-looking host
programs.how: Sign up at freedns.afraid.org and claim a subdomain on a shared domain. Site still live 21 Aug 2026.

programs.name: DuckDNS
programs.who: Anyone who needs a stable hostname for a changing IP
programs.how: Log in with GitHub/Google and claim you.duckdns.org. Dynamic DNS, not a personal brand.

programs.name: ClouDNS free zone
programs.who: Anyone who wants a hostname plus DNS records
programs.how: Create a free account, add a Free Zone, pick a hostname on their shared suffixes. Wiki article/31 still 200.

programs.name: pp.ua
programs.who: Anyone who can complete their form
programs.how: pp.ua still serves the signup pages (21 Aug 2026). They tell you to check availability on dig.ua, then use their register/activate forms. Do not invent Telegram or phone rules.

programs.name: Open Domains
programs.cost: Marketed as $0 on a new site — GitHub register is archived
programs.who: Students and open-source projects, if the new platform is the same project
programs.how: Do not open a GitHub PR. open-domains/register is archived (checked 21 Aug 2026). README says the service moved to open-domains.com; open-domains.net meta-refreshes there. Existing GitHub names stay live but cannot be edited via GitHub. We do not treat the new site as confirmed $0.

programs.name: cluster.ws / wip.la (Olivr)
programs.who: Nobody — maintainer says the zones hit Cloudflare’s 1,000-record limit
programs.how: Olivr/free-domain README (checked 21 Aug 2026): CURRENTLY THIS IS NOT WORKING ANYMORE. Last commits are Dec 2025. Do not file a PR.

programs.name: Freenom (.tk .cf .gq .ga .ml)
programs.who: Nobody — free regs ended 2024 after Meta sued. 2026: paid again, not $0.
programs.how: Do not chase leftover Freenom names. They are not a free pile. freenom.com still redirects to a paid domain panel.
